We deliver a deep dive into Banijay’s massive €32bn wager on a non‑existent market, highlighting a new value map for gaming and showcasing strategic foresight on media‑gaming convergence.
Our internal reporting on the Czech Republic’s ban of Polymarket and mandatory ISP blocking demonstrates timely coverage of regulatory actions affecting prediction‑market platforms.

Our internal article highlights the UK Gambling Commission’s consideration to suspend Evolution’s licence due to AML failings, offering early insight into compliance risks that competitors only touch on later.
Our internal reporting highlighted Greece’s modest revenue rise and land‑based dominance ahead of competitors, demonstrating early insight into the market’s growth trajectory.
